company.name: Quilt Data
company.shortDescription: Quilt is a data collaboration engine for S3 to make data way faster and more trustworthy.
company.description:
Quilt makes data-driven companies more collaborative by allowing everyone in the organization—not just data scientists— to work with data in a way that is faster, more collaborative and more trustworthy.

Organizations that use Quilt make informed decisions more rapidly, allowing them to be more successful and gain an unfair advantage in today’s increasingly data-driven world.
